# Umonics Plus

> > The Umonics Method is a record-breaking preschool memory training program founded by Sancy Suraj that develops cognitive abilities and IQ in young learners through developmentally appropriate activities.

Umonics Plus offers comprehensive early childhood education resources based on The Umonics Method, a proven preschool curriculum recognized in Singapore. The platform provides guides, activities, and strategies for normally developing children and those with special needs, emphasizing memory training, cognitive development, and balanced digital learning.
